complexity.countMeaning: Counts of authored formal component/feature responsibilities, not built runtime meshes or recovered source inventory.

referenceLimitations.description: User approved 9 columns and 8 sector panels as initial model counts; supplied images do not establish exact source counts.
Formal spec records the starting camera and pixel landmarks; calibration must be proved by a later render.
All 3 support crops failed automatic foreground isolation. They cannot be numeric silhouette ground truth and need consistency/mask work before quantitative use.
Hologram color families are visible, but physical PBR parameters and exact opacity are not recovered.
Exact source data-glyph counts are unknown; later detail pass must use region-guided deterministic placement and review pixel density.

previousEntries: Human review of the proposed 9-column layout and 8 outer sector panels.
Confirm or adjust the annular base plus faint inner projected-field interpretation and proposed ratios.
Formal ObjectSculptSpec and partial-angle sector geometry contract must be authored after dimensional review.
Supporting crop masks and cross-view correspondences are unverified; no numeric silhouette comparison against these views is authorized.
decisions: User confirmed the initial geometric proposal; counts are design choices, not source facts.
Existing profile2D/extrude emission can author sector volumes; formal local-axis contracts will specify placement.
Support-view limitation is retained as an exclusion from quantitative review, not silently declared solved.

preSpecAssessment.uncertaintyPolicy: All required initial geometry parameters are explicit. No trial parameter is declared visually accepted. Current authorization covers formal specification and validation only.

definitionOfDone: Match the primary image's stepped core, annular collars, finite-height outer ring and unequal radial tower hierarchy.
Preserve outer radial sector panels, base-registered violet loop, multiple grid coordinate systems and localized data marks.
Review neutral geometry before color/glow; schema validation never establishes camera calibration or fidelity.
Supporting views guide qualitative structure only until admitted and checked for geometric consistency.

screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

actionReadiness.contract: Factory wrapper root owns assembly transforms. Named component pivots, sockets, no-physics collider metadata and stable assembly groups support later picking/exploded inspection; current batch implements none.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Reserve root for factory wrapper; no component uses ID root.
Physical cap overlap uses parent-local endpoints; independently projected layers have no fabricated physical contact.
Child contour/highlight details travel with semantic owner.
Source adapter must use the same part identity for picking and exploded inspection.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: User approved 9 tower instances and 8 radial sector panels as initial design counts, not as verified source inventory.
World dimensions and polar coordinates are approved starting hypotheses, to be checked in neutral blockout.
The middle collar is represented as an annulus around a narrower core, not a wider filled cylinder.
An annular base plus a faint inner projection field is a geometric interpretation, not proof of a physical through-hole.
No exact PBR reconstruction, source-camera calibration or hidden-side recovery is claimed.
